title: 英文情境短劇 EP1：咖啡廳點餐（JV Tutor Corner）

shots.prompt: standing at the cafe counter, looking up at the menu board
shots.motion: she walks up to the counter and looks up at the menu board, thinking

shots.prompt: barista behind the counter wearing a dark apron, friendly smile
shots.motion: he looks up, smiles warmly and greets the customer
shots.line: Hi! What can I get for you today?

shots.prompt: at the cafe counter, polite and slightly unsure expression
shots.motion: she thinks for a second, then answers politely with a small smile
shots.line: Can I get a medium latte, please?
shots.translation: 可以給我一杯中杯拿鐵嗎？

shots.label: 今日句型 1
shots.note: 點餐最常用，比 I want... 更禮貌
shots.line: Can I get a medium latte, please?

shots.prompt: barista behind the counter wearing a dark apron, nodding
shots.motion: he nods and asks a quick question with a smile
shots.line: Sure. For here or to go?

shots.prompt: at the cafe counter, relaxed friendly expression
shots.motion: she answers, then adds a request, gesturing lightly with her hand
shots.line: To go, please. Could I have it with oat milk?
shots.translation: 外帶，謝謝。可以換燕麥奶嗎？

shots.label: 今日句型 2
shots.note: 回答：For here. / To go, please.

shots.label: 今日句型 3
shots.line: Could I have it with oat milk?

shots.prompt: barista wearing a dark apron handing a paper coffee cup across the counter
shots.motion: he hands over the latte across the counter with a smile

shots.prompt: holding a paper coffee cup, bright happy smile
shots.motion: she smiles, raises the cup slightly and says thank you
shots.line: Thank you! Have a nice day!
shots.translation: 謝謝！祝你有美好的一天！

shots.label: JV Tutor Corner
shots.note: 線上家教平台．用點數彈性上課
